title: Chapter 1229
text:
Boom! Boom!

Boom! The light of psionic explosions flashed in space, and the Mech Legion charged out of the army camp and onto the battlefield.

Five figures wrapped in energy of different colors were drowned by the sea of machines. They shuttled back and forth among the machines like meteors, and the light of various abilities lit up in the gaps between the machines from time to time.

There were four classes among the five of them, and only the Mechanic was missing. The Mechanic, who had lost all his assets, was not chosen as a representative by the revived Primordial Ones.

Psionic Prime led dozens of Apostle Weapons to fight the five of them. With the enhancement of Mechanical Force, the coordinated Apostle Weapons made the five of them flustered and in danger.

The Mechanical Deity was like a crane in a flock of chickens on the battlefield. The Celestial Punishment Edge chased after a few people and slashed continuously. The weapon was huge, but it was as fast as lightning, slashing out streaks of sharp psionic blade waves. The heavy normal attacks were mixed with the explosive moves of the Getta Hadoken, pouring out explosive lethality.

Pangon, in particular, received special attention. Han Xiao loved to persecute … no, educate arrogant kids the most.

However, the opponent this time was not old Manison, and he still needed to maintain his cool. Therefore, Han Xiao was more reserved and did not bombard the other party with chat streams.

The few of them fought fiercely for quite a while. Han Xiao was fighting one against five and did not show any signs of weakness for the time being. He was not at a disadvantage and even had a slight advantage. The mechanical army charged back and forth like a flock of crows, like a black rag trying to wipe away five stubborn stains.

Pangon, Beiger, and the other four were far from their peak strength, but they were not fodder either. Although they were in a passive position, they could still hold on for a while with their cooperation.

However, the five of them felt extremely troubled. This was their first time dealing with a Mechanic of this style, so they did not know where to start.

From what they knew, the best way to deal with a Mechanic was to attack them head-on. When they first saw Black Star's main body, they were quite surprised and felt that he was too careless. However, they now realized that they were ridiculously wrong. Black Star was the complete opposite of their impression of a Mechanic. One was as fragile as paper, while the other's mental strength, which should have been his weakness, was extremely tough. He was f * cking indestructible!

The head-on attack tactic was mostly useless. If they turned to attack the enemy's army, the enemy's foundation was too strong, and the secondary dimensional army box was still sending out soldiers continuously. They did not know when it would end.

Thinking about it, it seemed like they could only use a protracted battle to exhaust the enemy's energy. However, the enemy's Apostle Weapons, mechanical army, and Mechanical Deity were too powerful, so their margin of error was very low. Furthermore, their energy consumption was also very high.

If this went on, the five of them were not sure if they would be heavily injured first or if Black Star would run out of energy.

Does this person to time to time to attack to attack to death?

"I never thought that such a terrifying character would appear in this era!" Mei Ji exclaimed.

"if only my weapon was still here …" Pangon clenched his teeth as another dozen of his bones were shattered by the slash.

"save it. A Pugilist was beaten up by a Mechanic at close range, and you still have the face to talk?" another person could not help but say.

"alright, stop arguing and think of a way to deal with him. If we still get killed in a five-on-one battle, that will be extremely embarrassing," Beigon said with a deep voice.

The five of them dodged or blocked the focused attacks of the Mech Army like they were walking on a tightrope, trying to find Han Xiao's weakness. However, they could not find a way to break through the situation and were getting more and more passive.

With the support of [Fearless Heart] and [Legendary Battle Technique], the focused attacks of the Mech Army were extremely powerful. Among the five of them, only Pangon had True Damage Reduction. The other four would not be able to survive many rounds of attacks.

If not for a Psychic and Beigon continuously giving them shields, some of them might have already been heavily injured.

Most importantly, they were shocked to find that Han Xiao was becoming more and more courageous as he fought, and his strength was still increasing as he fought.

Beiger maintained the state of Phase Illusion and avoided the attacks of a few Apostle Weapons. He said decisively,

He said decisively, "the battle has already been dragged into the opponent's rhythm. If this continues, the situation will only get worse. Let's try again. The five of us will attack his main body together. I don't believe that his physique has no limit. Other than that, there are no other effective methods."

"what do you plan to do? His main body is now hidden in the Mechanical Deity and is being protected. "

"have you forgotten the forbidden space spell I have? I can temporarily pull the target out of the Mechanical Deity and create an opportunity. "

The few of them quickly reached a consensus. Beigon did not delay and formed a hand sign.

An exquisite enchantment circuit lit up on his neck, and a spatial repulsive force burst out with him as the center. The mechanical soldiers around him were all pushed far away, squeezing into a cluster.

Then, he raised his hand and cast a group blink spell, teleporting the other four to his side and gathering them together.

He did not stop chanting and instantly constructed a new magic circuit. The space not far away suddenly rippled. Han Xiao, who was supposed to be inside the Mechanical Deity, appeared out of thin air at the location Beigon had pointed out.

Han Xiao only felt his vision blur, and his position changed. He looked up and saw the concentrated fire of the five people charging toward him. The light was dazzling, and the momentum was fierce.

"yo, what a small combo."

Han Xiao even had the time to tease him. He then opened a new gate beside him. With a tug of his hand, rows of Spacetime Amber Balls were pulled out and stacked into a transparent wall in front of him.

Splash!

The next moment, the long-range attacks of the five of them hit the Spacetime Amber Barrier. Like water pillars landing on a lotus leaf, they immediately slid in all directions. Han Xiao, who was behind the barrier, was unharmed.

"what is that?"

Seeing this, the pupils of the five of them constricted.

At this time, Han Xiao's laughter sounded in the public channel.

"This Space Displacement spell is not bad. I have a similar ability too. Do you guys want to try it?"

As soon as he said that, Han Xiao's figure flashed, and he returned to the Mechanical Deity with Void Hyperdrive. Before the few of them could take any further measures, he immediately used Void Displacement and switched locations with one of his targets.

Whoosh!

Pangon's vision blurred, and he was shocked to find himself inside the Mechanical Deity. Before he could react, the space around him suddenly disintegrated, turning into a Mech Legion that surrounded him and focused fire on him immediately.

Iron Head Doll was being beaten up far away, and Han Xiao's figure switched to the other four.

Facing the shocked gazes of the four of them, he smiled, shook his body, and suddenly activated the Void Prison.

The next moment, the movements of the four of them became extremely stagnant, and they were all trapped in this domain. Only Han Xiao could move freely.

He activated Apostilization with all his strength, and countless mechanical troops fed back a huge amount of attributes to him. His right arm bent like a bow, and energy circuits lit up on the surface of the mechanical suit. Psionic energy rippled out like water.

"Getta Ripple Fist — Star Piercing Hammer!"

Han Xiao punched forward, and the fist wrapped in dazzling psionic energy hit Beiger's face. In the slow-motion view of the Void Prison, Beiger's face could clearly be seen shaking, deforming, and bursting open, with a stream of blood dripping out.

Boom!

A dark blue shockwave burst out, and Beiger was sent flying away.

Han Xiao did not stop moving. The firepower of the mechanical suit was at full power, and he punched the remaining three people in the face. It was as if there were afterimages shuttling back and forth between the three of them.

Kacha!

After being beaten up for a while, the few of them finally broke free from the restrictions of the Void Prison. They hurriedly retreated, and there was pain all over their bodies. They felt like they had been beaten up from head to toe dozens of times.

At the same time, Pangon, who was far away, was not locked up by the strong man. He crashed through the Mech Legion's blockade with difficulty and broke out of the encirclement. However, he was hit multiple times in a short period of time. He was covered in blood, and his injuries were not light.

Han Xiao stayed where he was and did not chase after him, but the five of them stayed far away from him. All of them had cautious and serious expressions on their faces.

"Hiss …"

Beiger held his bleeding face and was shocked. Not only did his strategy not work, but he was also beaten back by Han Xiao. The enemy could actually injure all five of them in a row, and Pangon was the most severely injured.

This series of results shocked the few of them. They did not know what special abilities Han Xiao had, so they did not dare approach him easily, fearing that they would be hit again.

Seeing that Han Xiao was sizing them up, the five of them became extremely vigilant and completely dispelled their last bit of contempt. They focused all their attention and nervously prepared for Han Xiao's next round of attacks.

However, at this moment, Han Xiao stopped all the movements of the Mech Legion. He glanced at everyone and chuckled softly.

"I think we should stop here. I'm sure everyone has a direct understanding of my abilities. If we continue to spar, the situation might not be very pleasant. I agree with Mei Ji's suggestion. Let's stop here and consider it a draw. Let's not hurt the harmony."

Hearing this, the five of them were stunned for a moment. Seeing that Han Xiao did not seem to be faking it, they relaxed their tense bodies.

They looked at each other and more or less showed bitter smiles, shame, and shame on their faces.

How could they not know that Black Star was giving them a way out so that they would feel better? However, this only hurt them more.

'How is this a draw? It's clearly five of us against one, and we're still being tortured!

'We don't feel comforted at all. We only feel embarrassed!'

"… A powerhouse like you is unique even in the exploration era. I admit defeat. We underestimated you."

Beiger sighed with a complicated expression.

After experiencing it firsthand, Black Star's combat strength was completely beyond their expectations, and they were completely stunned.

Even without that fancy combo, just based on the strength of the Mech Legion, everyone could see that Black Star's raw strength was far superior to theirs.

Thinking of this, their faces were more or less lonely, and their arrogance could not be found.

Putting themselves in their shoes, they could understand how big of a blow this was. The feeling of a new generation replacing the old was not good. It almost made them wonder if they had really been eliminated.

Pangon was the most embarrassed. His expression was uncertain, and the wounds on his body were still burning with pain. However, compared to the trauma in his heart, the physical pain was nothing. This unacceptable result made him doubt himself.

Han Xiao glanced at them, smiled, and said, "I might not have controlled my strength, so I used a little too much force. I hope you guys don't take it to heart."

"Ahem, this is a small matter. We don't mind."

Beiger blushed a little. He still remembered that he had said something similar to Black Star not long ago.

"Then, can we continue talking now?" Han Xiao shrugged.

"Of course, of course. Let's go down and continue."

Their attitude changed one hundred and eighty degrees, and their tone was filled with respect and reverence.

Although they were not used to this change psychologically, Beyond Grade As were respected, and their fists were the foundation. They naturally could not bring out their arrogant tone to face someone who could kill any one of them single-handedly.

Seeing this, Han Xiao smiled and returned to the surface of the planet. He immediately saw Oathkeeper staring at him.

"Why are you looking at me like that?"

"… Nothing."

Oathkeeper suppressed the shock in his heart and tried to make his tone sound natural and calm.

The strength that Han Xiao had just displayed had also given him a fright!

Unlike the other Primordial Ones, Oathkeeper knew that Han Xiao was strong, but he did not expect him to be this strong!

Before today, Oathkeeper felt that he was on par with Black Star. However, after witnessing Black Star's battle with his own eyes, he strongly suspected that his judgment was wrong. Black Star's true strength was much stronger than the rumors!

Fake news really killed people!

Oathkeeper could not help but feel glad that he did not choose to silence Han Xiao. Otherwise, he would have been the one to be silenced.

…

At the same time, the remote monitoring room of the Holy Covenant spaceship far away was dead silent. It was so quiet that even a pin drop could be heard.

The many Primordial Ones watching the battle were stunned. Their eyes were wide open, and they were speechless from shock.

After more than ten seconds, someone finally spoke in shock, his tone filled with disbelief.

"Five against one, and they still lost?"

As soon as these words came out, everyone instantly exploded, and the entire room was in an uproar.

"This is the strength of a modern Beyond Grade A?"

"From the looks of it, he seems to be doing it with ease. Pangon's group of five couldn't even find out his limit!"

"What's his Energy Rank? Eighty thousand? Ninety thousand? Could it be that he broke through the hundred thousand mark? "

"Maybe he's right. We're outdated. Times have really changed …"

The Primordial Ones present felt like their worldview was shattered. At first, they thought that Black Star was just showing off, but in the end, they realized that he was really strong. They felt like their faces had been slapped.

Luckily, they were only watching the battle behind the scenes and did not have to care about their faces. In their eyes, a loss was a loss, and a loss was a loss. Naturally, they did not take the result of a draw seriously.

Thinking back to what Black Star said before the battle, they felt like eggplants that had been hit by frost. Their confidence took a huge hit, and their sense of superiority as Primordial Ones was completely destroyed.

It seemed like he really was not boasting. He taught them a lesson and helped them recognize reality …

The people present had no choice but to accept this reality. The arrogance, arrogance, and other mentality they had when they first revived quickly disappeared, turning into caution, modesty, and caution.

The only problem was that the effect was too good. Many people's mentality had fallen to the other extreme …

"Black Star is only the vice president of the Beyond Grade A Association. The Internet says that there are many Beyond Grade As in the same echelon as him, so they should have similar strength … Tsk, the modern era is too scary!"

Among the crowd, some of the Primordial Ones who originally planned to start afresh started to think about retreating, deeply doubting whether they had the capital to start afresh.

Originally, the goal of some people's revival was to avoid the exploration era war and come to the peaceful era to develop a new organization with their own strength and obtain great power.

However, Han Xiao's performance today gave them the wrong impression that there were experts like him everywhere.

This spar had not only destroyed their self-confidence, but it had also scared some of them into temporarily burying their ambitions.

With our strength, we'll be courting death if we rush to start something. It's better to train in seclusion for a few decades first. We won't come out until we catch up with the times.
